environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with a Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function processes CI/CD webhook payloads and executes pipeline steps. The function URL endpoint is publicly accessible at https://abc123.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/. No API Gateway, no CloudFront, no additional authentication layer. The Lambda execution role has AmazonSSMReadOnlyAccess and SecretsManagerReadWrite for pipeline secret injection.
